require max dressed/preferred source identity residual <1e-11

next_if_pass: freeze a physical finite-onset memory-loss/growing-mode test using a declared completion-parameter diagnostic point only after the parameter protocol is frozen; do not infer attractor behavior from this synthetic smoke-test
